$schema.$comment: Not a real JSON Schema — a note to whoever opens this file next.
$schema.purpose: The translator's brief. One entry per key that needs one, written ONCE in English and reused for every language, forever. This file is build-time only and is never shipped to browsers.
$schema.why: A bare dictionary strips exactly what a translator needs. Given {"status.boost.action": "Boost"} and asked for Chinese, a model has no way to know Boost is a fediverse noun-verb meaning 're-share unmodified' rather than 'amplify/promote' — so it produces something in the register of a municipal economic-development slogan. It is not being stupid; it was handed a word with no referent.

fields.desc: REQUIRED. What the string means and does. Disambiguates every homograph.
fields.surface: Where it renders (button, paragraph, tooltip, placeholder). Register and length follow from this.
fields.max: Soft character budget. German compounds and Finnish cases overflow narrow buttons; a translator must know when it is tight.
fields.glossary: Glossary terms this string uses. Forces consistency with the translate-ui skill.
fields.pos: noun / verb / adjective. Post, Boost, Like, Filter and Mute are all both in English.
fields.tone: neutral / playful / warning / error. This app is wry in places; a warning must not be.
fields.placeholders: What each {{param}} holds, so it is never translated or reordered blindly.
fields.dnt: Do not translate — brand names, handles, hashtags, product names.

$schema.coverage: Deliberately NOT required to be complete. Most keys (Cancel, Save, Settings) are unambiguous, and demanding an entry for each would be make-work that trains everyone to write 'the save button' to silence a gate. The one rule worth enforcing: a key whose English contains a glossary term must have an entry.

footer.rules.desc: Link to the server's own rules and terms-of-service page. {{host}} is a domain name like 'mastodon.social'.

placeholders.host: A server domain name, or the word Server when unknown.

footer.server.desc: Stands in for the server's domain name when we don't know it yet. Reads as '<Server> rules & terms'.

footer.source.desc: Link to this app's source code on GitHub. 'Mockingbird' is the product name.

footer.reportBug.desc: Opens a dialog for reporting a problem with the app.

footer.privacy.desc: Link to the privacy section of the credits page.

footer.failWhale.desc: Link to a deliberately silly error page. A joke referencing early Twitter's overload mascot — a whale lifted by birds. Keep the joke or find the local equivalent; a literal 'whale that failed' is wrong.

footer.hotkeys.desc: Opens the keyboard-shortcuts overlay. The literal '?' is the key you press, so keep it as a character.

footer.hotkeys.title.desc: Tooltip for the shortcuts button. '?' is the keyboard key.

footer.end.desc: Reassurance at the bottom of a feed. The joke: this app's feeds are finite and end, unlike an infinite scroll, and stopping is fine. Render the reassurance, not the words.

footer.builtAt.desc: When this build was produced. {{date}} is a preformatted UTC timestamp; 'UTC' is a technical abbreviation.

placeholders.date: Preformatted timestamp, already localized. Never translate or reformat.

footer.buildLog.desc: Link to this build's CI run log. Lowercase on purpose — it sits mid-sentence.

localePicker.label.desc: Accessible name for the control that changes the language of the app's interface. Not the language of posts — that is a separate setting.
localePicker.label.surface: screen-reader label and aria-label on a select

localePicker.auto.desc: The option meaning 'follow whatever language my browser asks for', as opposed to forcing one. Selecting it clears the stored choice.
localePicker.auto.surface: first option in a language select

flags.proxyAllorigins.label.desc: The four public CORS proxies are on the chopping block (2026-08-30) — they each failed often enough that they default to off. Do not translate: the strings are due for deletion, and translating them would leave an orphan in every locale. Only the Mawkingbird Plus proxy and a self-hosted proxy stay.
